input_encoding: Inherit the frozen manifest inputs and native slice layout; typed decimal strings are decoded without float conversion

cases.sql: SELECT CAST(make_ym_interval() AS STRING) AS r
cases.purpose: Observe the zero-argument defaults without an argument conversion.

cases.sql: SELECT id,CAST(make_ym_interval(v) AS STRING) AS years_r,CAST(make_ym_interval(0L,v) AS STRING) AS months_r FROM narrow_required WHERE id BETWEEN 5 AND 7 ORDER BY id
cases.purpose: Observe required BIGINT values -1, 0 and 1 as years with an omitted month, and as months with both arguments supplied.

cases.sql: SELECT id,CAST(make_ym_interval(0L,v) AS STRING) AS r FROM narrow_nullable WHERE id BETWEEN 4 AND 8 OR id=14 ORDER BY id
cases.purpose: Observe nullable BIGINT months at both INT limits, ordinary values and NULL with supplied BIGINT years.

cases.sql: SELECT CAST(make_ym_interval(v,1L) AS STRING) AS r FROM narrow_required WHERE id=12
cases.purpose: Isolate required years 4294967297 so argument narrowing is visible before interval arithmetic.

cases.sql: SELECT CAST(make_ym_interval(1L,v) AS STRING) AS r FROM narrow_required WHERE id=1
cases.purpose: Isolate negative required months -4294967297 to distinguish signed low-bit conversion from clipping or NULL substitution.

cases.sql: SELECT id,CAST(make_ym_interval(v,1L) AS STRING) AS years_r,CAST(make_ym_interval(1L,v) AS STRING) AS months_r FROM narrow_nullable_sliced WHERE id IN (5,6,7,14) ORDER BY id
cases.purpose: Observe valid and NULL nullable years and months through the existing sliced native provider with hidden BIGINT extrema.

cases.sql: SELECT CAST(make_ym_interval(0L,v) AS STRING) AS r FROM narrow_required_sliced WHERE id=11
cases.purpose: Isolate months 4294967296 through the existing required sliced native provider.

cases.sql: SELECT CAST(make_ym_interval(v,0L) AS STRING) AS r FROM narrow_nullable WHERE id=11
cases.purpose: Isolate years 4294967296 in a nullable source without relying on a literal-only adapter path.

cases.sql: SELECT id,CAST(make_ym_interval(v,v) AS STRING) AS r FROM narrow_nulls ORDER BY id
cases.purpose: Observe both nullable BIGINT parameters on the registered all-NULL provider.

cases.sql: SELECT id,CAST(make_ym_interval(v,v) AS STRING) AS r FROM narrow_empty_nullable ORDER BY id
cases.purpose: Observe public and execution fields for two nullable BIGINT parameters without input rows.

cases.sql: SELECT id,CASE WHEN false THEN CAST(make_ym_interval(v,0L) AS STRING) ELSE 'kept' END AS dead_r,CASE WHEN CAST(NULL AS BOOLEAN) THEN CAST(make_ym_interval(v,0L) AS STRING) ELSE CAST(NULL AS STRING) END AS null_r FROM narrow_required ORDER BY id
cases.purpose: Observe statically false and NULL CASE conditions over required years that include narrowing and arithmetic boundaries.

cases.sql: SELECT CAST(make_ym_interval(v,CAST(NULL AS BIGINT)) AS STRING) AS r FROM narrow_required WHERE id=11
cases.purpose: Observe a statically NULL month beside required years 4294967296 and retain the actual conversion versus NULL-folding priority.

cases.sql: SELECT CAST(make_ym_interval(4294967296L,0L,0L) AS STRING) AS r
cases.purpose: Record actual wrong-arity priority with an overflowing BIGINT argument.
Record actual incompatible-month-type priority with an overflowing BIGINT year argument.

cases.sql: SELECT CAST(make_ym_interval(v,0L) AS STRING) AS r FROM narrow_required WHERE id=8
cases.purpose: Observe existing interval multiplication for years 2147483647, which fits the INT argument conversion.

cases.sql: SELECT CAST(make_ym_interval(1L,v) AS STRING) AS r FROM narrow_required WHERE id=8
cases.purpose: Observe existing interval addition for months 2147483647 after both BIGINT arguments fit INT.
